the modified Newtonian dynamics (MOND) is an effective theory to explain the dynamics of spiral galaxies.
the mass distribution of the modified Newtonian dynamics can be derived from the surface mass density.
the modified Newtonian dynamics (MOND) can be applied to the study the dynamics of highly flattened spiral galaxies.

the study of the mass distribution of the galaxies and the corresponding dynamics.

the mass distribution of MOND is more concentrated than Newtonian one, and the mass of MOND is larger than Newtonian one.

the dynamics of galaxies is determined by the mass distribution, not the potential.

the elliptic function can be used to describe the dynamics of galaxies in a more accurate way.
